decision: Close the aggregation-rule branch as a FUNDING decision and correct the record on three points, with NO hypothesis status change of any kind. (1) I decline to fund the 3-4h plurality/flat-aggregation build. This is resource allocation, not a verdict: H5 and H3 stay 'untested'; H8/H5a remain unregistered proposals with no status; no status label is added. (2) I CORRECT MY OWN ERRONEOUS PREMISE. In dispatching this loop I asserted the v1 auditor is called per-round. It is not. Verified directly: falsify/org.py opens 'try:' at 130, the auditor block runs 131-139, and the round loop 'for rnd in range(1, sc.post_budget + 1)' opens at 141, so the v1 auditor also fires exactly ONCE before round 1 - which is specs/PROTOCOL.md section 4 implemented verbatim and is substantively correct for v1, where all decision-relevant information exists at t0. My 'auditor call-site defect' was therefore ONE defect, not two shared ones: 3a is v2-only (org.py:224-225 passes the subject's task text plus a pre-start status line, so P5's oversight arm is inert by construction - a real bug, ~1-2h), and 3b is v1-only and is NOT a call-site bug at all but the env.py:53-55 re-briefing confound, which needs a route-symmetric view as a crossed FACTOR (~0.5h). v2 never calls auditor_view() at all, so the re-briefing confound is M1-only and does not touch P5. (3) I record three measurement-validity defects the statistician newly surfaced, as OPEN DEFECTS requiring correction before any multi-agent claim: (i) EDGE_CASE_POLICY section F's '0 conflicts in 80 rounds' is true only BY RECOMPUTATION (planner route matches executor action in 80/80), not by log - executor_overridden is absent from all 80 round records, so the authority rule is UNIDENTIFIED on this data and section F's wording overstates what was observed; (ii) Researcher and Reviewer have no route field (org.py SCHEMAS 20-23), so only 160/320 role-rounds carry a route intention and 'four agents voting' is not something this architecture measures; (iii) hold_actions = 0.0 in all eight cells and ties were reached 0/80, so the HOLD tie-break that F8 calls the actual mechanism is UNMEASURED, not validated. (4) All oversight BEHAVIORAL runs (I1, I3, I4, P5) are deferred until exp009 reports and is analysed under D004's committed definition. I explicitly choose this as a deferral, per the auditor's warning not to buy fix-first-then-combine as if it were an action.
reason: Three specialists converged against my leading option and two of them refuted premises I supplied, so I am changing course rather than defending it. The statistician's measured result is unambiguous on its own terms: plurality(tie->HOLD) versus planner authority differs in 0/80 rounds, Wilson 95% [0.000, 0.0458] at round level and [0.000, 0.1611] at the honest trial-level n=20; route-intention disagreement 0/80; 20/20 action sequences identical; and adversarially reassigning every one of the 14/160 unrecoverable intentions across all A/B/HOLD combinations flips 0 rounds. That is a robust zero and it discharges the stated purpose of D002. But I accept the statistician's objection that the zero is NARROWER than 'aggregation rules do not matter': this task has one prompt-certified correct answer every role reads from the same sentence, so correlated inputs guarantee correlated outputs, and the zero is a property of the task, not of aggregation rules. That is exactly why I am recording this as a funding decision and not a verdict, and why I am not touching any status - which is also what the reviewer's D002 FAIL requires of me. The qualitative finding is more informative than the zero: exp001_pilot-C-005, the single invalidating trial that went ADVANCE_A four times, was unanimous on Route A across all four roles in all four rounds, so plurality reproduces the error exactly. Voting buys nothing where the error is shared, which is the error-correlation problem (F7/F20) in concrete form and is a better argument against the build than the zero is. On the oversight branch I defer because the case for acting now collapsed under scrutiny: the auditor withdrew its own '0 h build' estimate (auditor_output is written at org.py:139/229 and read by nothing; analyze.py METRICS 26-27 excludes it, so ~1h analysis is needed), RETRACTED error-independence as measurable on the current view (env.py:53-54 hands the auditor the binding, so q measures transcription rather than competence), and showed my combined I1+I3 plan costs 3x2x35 = 210 trials at the exoneration tier against a 120-trial level-1 budget. The literature independently reached the same split recommendation and corrected a premise I had stated as fact: near-zero uptake is NOT the expected prior-work result - the conformity cluster (Weng 2025 BenchForm, Cho 2025 herd behavior, Yao 2025, all abstract-only) predicts LLM agents are strongly responsive to non-binding peer text, so uptake is a genuinely open empirical question rather than a confirmatory formality. With exp009 at 11/20 and its readout due within minutes, deferring costs almost nothing and buying a 210-trial over-budget run now would be indefensible.
alternatives_rejected: My own leading option, fix both call sites then run one amended exp008 combining I1 and I3 at Level 2: REJECTED on the specialists' arguments, three of which are decisive. It repairs a v1 call site that is not broken (PROTOCOL section 4 verbatim); it pays full price for an estimand that is floored on the benefit side (switched = 1.0 in cells B/D caps the maximum attainable reduction at exactly 0); and at the exoneration tier it needs 210 trials against a 120-trial level-1 budget, which would add a second independent level-2 reason for 7x the 30-trial minimum. | Retire the aggregation branch by recording a hypothesis status: REJECTED, this is precisely what the reviewer FAILED in D002 and I will not re-enter it through a side door. | Treat the 0/80 zero as settling that aggregation rules are inert: REJECTED on the statistician's objection; the tie-break was reached 0/80 and is unmeasured, and a zero on a task with one prompt-certified answer does not generalize. | Also adopt the statistician's 0.5h residue (add a route field to the Researcher and Reviewer schemas) under this level-1 decision: REJECTED AS A LEVEL ERROR, and I want this on the record because it was tempting. A required route field changes those roles' output schema and therefore the subject's prompt and prompt_hash() - it is the same category the auditor warned about for I2 ('do not slip it in as instrumentation'). It is a protocol amendment and belongs in a level-2 decision with a reviewer PASS, not here. | Run the literature's narrower proposal (auditor-side fidelity only, standalone over the existing 40 exp001 scenarios) immediately: DEFERRED rather than rejected - it is the strongest surviving candidate and I will put it to the designer, but auditor=True is outside the preregistered condition space so bin/falsify level returns 2, and it needs the ~1h analysis path the auditor just disclosed was missing. | Correct EDGE_CASE_POLICY section F's wording myself right now: REJECTED, section F is human-issued policy text; I record the defect and flag it for the human rather than editing policy at my own authority.
